description.text: The other seventh expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released together with Skyscraping Perfection in July 2021, with more Dragon Pokémon without Weakness. Blue Sky Stream holds the Rapid Strike cards, led by Rayquaza VMAX: its attack discards any number of basic Fire or Lightning Energy from it for more damage, and its Ability discards its player's hand to draw three cards. Dragonite V, whose attack does 250 damage, Flapple, Appletun, Ampharos, Gyarados VMAX and Trevenant VMAX join it, with Zinnia's Resolve, a Supporter that draws a card for each of the opponent's Pokémon, and the Stadium Stormy Mountains, which brings a Lightning or Dragon Basic Pokémon from the deck to the Bench each turn. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 67, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters with a second Rayquaza VMAX drawn as a full scene, and gold Ultra Rare Froslass, Toy Catcher, Stormy Mountains and Lightning Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Evolving Skies in August 2021 and Fusion Strike in November 2021.
